idw.rule: weights 1 / max(d, min_distance_km)^p over the input neighbours, normalized to sum 1; p is the value of configs/design.json interp.idw_search with the lowest RMSE on the 2016-2023 fit rows

kriging.fit: rho_ij = C_ij / sqrt(C_ii C_jj), C the WVHT covariance of each station pair over the 2016-2023 hours both reported (np.cov, ddof 1); rho0 and L by least squares of log rho on d over the pairs with positive covariance (log rho = log rho0 - d / L); c0 = rho0 times the mean of C_ii

aniso.rule: separations measured after rotating by the angle and stretching the minor axis by 1 / ratio; c0 and L refitted for every candidate with the kriging fit; the candidate with the lowest RMSE on the 2016-2023 fit rows is selected (stored as val_rmse) (ratio 1 is tried once, at angle 0). The angle is circular and has no edge; the ratio has an edge at its smallest value and follows the boundary rule
